---
type: memory
title: "FOIL: which terms get multiplied?"
---

Match each **FOIL letter** to the bracket where its two multiplied terms are shown in red.

| Letter | Terms multiplied |
|:------:|:-----------------|
| F | $(\textcolor{#A60000}{a} + b)(\textcolor{#A60000}{c} + d)$ |
| O | $(\textcolor{#A60000}{a} + b)(c + \textcolor{#A60000}{d})$ |
| I | $(a + \textcolor{#A60000}{b})(\textcolor{#A60000}{c} + d)$ |
| L | $(a + \textcolor{#A60000}{b})(c + \textcolor{#A60000}{d})$ |

## Hint
**F**irst: the first term in each bracket. **L**ast: the last term in each bracket.

## Hint
**O**uter: the two terms on the far ends. **I**nner: the two in the middle, next to each other.

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  % area model: each FOIL product is one box of the rectangle
  \draw[seg] (0,0) rectangle (4,3.2);
  \draw[seg] (2.4,0) -- (2.4,3.2);
  \draw[seg] (0,1.2) -- (4,1.2);
  \node[above] at (1.2,3.2) {$c$};
  \node[above] at (3.2,3.2) {$+d$};
  \node[left] at (0,2.2) {$a$};
  \node[left] at (0,0.6) {$+b$};
  \node at (1.2,2.2) {F: $ac$};
  \node at (3.2,2.2) {O: $ad$};
  \node at (1.2,0.6) {I: $bc$};
  \node at (3.2,0.6) {L: $bd$};
  \node at (2,-0.6) {$(a+b)(c+d) = ac + ad + bc + bd$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```

## Solution
Add the four products:
$$
\begin{aligned}
    (a + b)(c + d) &= \underbrace{ac}_{F} + \underbrace{ad}_{O} + \underbrace{bc}_{I} + \underbrace{bd}_{L}
\end{aligned}
$$

For example, $(x + 3)(x + 5) = x^2 + 5x + 3x + 15 = x^2 + 8x + 15$.
